definitions.explanation: A condition where blood accumulates in a part of the body, making it appear red. Most commonly used to describe bloodshot eyes, but can refer to any area with excessive blood flow.

examples.japanese: {目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}している。
{寝不足|ねぶそく}で{目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}してしまった。
examples.english: My eyes became bloodshot from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: {花粉症|かふんしょう}のせいで{目|め}がかゆくて{充血|じゅうけつ}がひどい。
examples.english: Due to hay fever, my eyes are itchy and severely bloodshot.

notes:
Composed of {充|じゅう} (fill, be full) + {血|けつ} (blood). Functions as a suru verb: {充血|じゅうけつ}する.

MOST COMMON USE:
{目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}する (eyes become bloodshot) is by far the most frequent context.

COMMON CAUSES:
- {寝不足|ねぶそく}: lack of sleep
- {花粉症|かふんしょう}: hay fever
- {疲|つか}れ{目|め}: eye strain
- アレルギー: allergies
- {長時間|ちょうじかん}のパソコン{作業|さぎょう}: long computer work

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {目|め}が{充血|じゅうけつ}している: eyes are bloodshot
- {充血|じゅうけつ}がひどい: severely bloodshot
- {充血|じゅうけつ}を{抑|おさ}える: to reduce redness

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
In medical terminology, {充血|じゅうけつ} (hyperemia) can refer to blood congestion in any body part, not just eyes.
